data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [While the delivery of the wallpaper was…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6418e8a2b23781c84232b5ba)
Update: Liam from Lulu & Georgia got in touch with me and offered solution to my order issues. Thanks for making it right. I will definitely buy again now! 

Original review: While the delivery of the wallpaper was faster than expected, I received a different wallpaper color than the one I asked for. 

Not satisfied with the lack of attention to detail. And customer service is nonexistent despite my attempts to contact them. Will not buy again from this company.

March 20, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Mar 21, 2023

Hi Rosa,

We thank you for reaching out and we're sorry to hear we sent the wrong wallpaper to you. One of our reps is currently working on a resolution for this with our supplier. If you have any further questions or concerns, please reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com.
